reviews.text: My Dog has stayed here 3 times, he is well looked after and comes home happy and sleepy (which we want). Alan and Brendagh and lovely people and care for what they do. Reggie will be back again soon 😊 …
Our dog is always given 5 star treatment and comes home in top form.

The owners have always looked after our baby Lulu and recently when she was unwell they promptly got her to my vet as I was on holidays in Canada at tge time and saved her life ...10 out of 10 everytime
My dog Mylo stayed with Alan for 16nights. No problems. Would 100% recommend.
Thank you David

My dog Lexi stayed here for a few days this week and couldn't be happier from chatting to Alan and the staff upon drop off as it was her first time in kennels. She came back happy and exhausted so I know she was well looked after and happy for the few days there. Can't thank them enough.
Thor loves going to West City Kennels. Hes always so looked after. Always runs into the place. Wouldn't send him anywhere else.

Our dogs seem to absolutely love going and get all excited when they get out of the car. You know they love it when they’re excited to get in! Dogs always come back, clean, happy and healthy! We’ve trusted Alan and Brendagh for years!
Always great spot staff lovely
Great place and my boys came back happy and healthy. Very happy

my dog just stayed with West City for most of last week. she was so well looked after. when we picked her up you knew by the way she walked up the avenue towards us she was totally at ease. i would highly recommend Alan and the rest of the team.

Outstanding service from Brendagh, Grace and Alan. A wonderful family fun business. The cattery kennels were large and put together so well. Smelt lovely and clean and the place was spotless. Brendagh is a wonderful kind person. She answered all my questions and even sent me photos of our cat while we were away. Grace and Alan were also so chatty and kind to us. I would definitely highly recommend them.

Both my dogs have been going here for the past few years now. They run in with excitement and always come home happy and healthy. The staff are lovely to deal with and once I shoot them a text they keep me updated on how the dogs are doing. Couldn't recommend these guys more! Would love to see some more photos or social media content of what goes on behind the scenes😊

We left our cat here for 3 days and could not recommend it less. They collected her at the gate and wouldn't let us see where she would be staying. No contact or updates during the stay. When we collected her she was legitimately …
Our dog loves it here, been going since we had him. Drop off and collection is easy. Staff very friendly

Using these guys 20 years now for all of our dogs. Its a good sign and a relief when your dogs actually are excited to go in to Kennels. Never once had an issue with infection or ailments once your dog is healthy going in, they will be very well looked after here.
Thanks darragh - bella is such a sweetheart
Very happy with the service and trust they look after our doggie well, he’s always in good form when we pick him up and the staff are very nice

A kennel should be a place that takes care of your pets and not just a place where they sleep while you are away. You trust a kennel with the well-being of your dogs and expect them to be taken care of in case they become ill. Both of our …

Please do NOT leave your dogs here! I picked up my dogs, both with eye infections. its week three now and one is still. But the worst part was that when I gave the owners, Brendagh, feedback she denied it and basically accused me of lying! They are very unprofessional. I do not advise this place at all.
Alan & Brendagh mind my dogs well & they go in the gate without a backward glance at me!
